## Basic Usage

State persists across cells:

````markdown
```{term}
export GREETING="Hello from quarto-term"
```

```{term}
echo $GREETING
```
````

```{term}
export GREETING="Hello from quarto-term"
```

```{term}
echo $GREETING
```

## Multi-Line Commands

Loops and other multi-line constructs work automatically via PS2 detection:

````markdown
```{term}
for i in 1 2 3; do
  echo "Item $i"
done
```
````

```{term}
for i in 1 2 3; do
  echo "Item $i"
done
```

## ANSI Colors

Colored output renders faithfully:

````markdown
```{term}
printf '\033[31mred\033[0m \033[32mgreen\033[0m \033[34mblue\033[0m\n'
```
````

```{term}
printf '\033[31mred\033[0m \033[32mgreen\033[0m \033[34mblue\033[0m\n'
```

## Working with Files

````markdown
```{term}
echo "line 1" > /tmp/demo.txt
echo "line 2" >> /tmp/demo.txt
echo "line 3" >> /tmp/demo.txt
cat /tmp/demo.txt
```
````

```{term}
echo "line 1" > /tmp/demo.txt
echo "line 2" >> /tmp/demo.txt
echo "line 3" >> /tmp/demo.txt
cat /tmp/demo.txt
```

## Piping

Multi-line pipes work naturally:

````markdown
```{term}
seq 1 5 |
paste -sd+ |
bc
```
````

```{term}
seq 1 5 |
paste -sd+ |
bc
```

## Interrupting a Command

Send a long-running command, then interrupt it:

````markdown
```{term}
sleep 100 #! expect-prompt: false
ctrl-c #! literal: false, delay: 0.5, expect-prompt: true
```
````

```{term}
sleep 100 #! expect-prompt: false
ctrl-c #! literal: false, delay: 0.5, expect-prompt: true
```

## Arrow Key Navigation

Recall and re-execute the previous command using multiple keys on one line:

````markdown
```{term}
echo "first command"
up enter #! literal: false, delay: 0.3
```
````

```{term}
echo "first command"
up enter #! literal: false, delay: 0.3
```

## Cell-Level Key Defaults

Set `literal: false` and `delay` as cell defaults to avoid repeating line options:

````markdown
```{term}
#| literal: false
#| delay: 0.2
echo "first command" #! literal: true
up
enter
```
````

```{term}
#| literal: false
#| delay: 0.2
echo "first command" #! literal: true
up
enter
```

```{term}
#| include: false
rm -f /tmp/demo.txt
```
